# Onboarding Problem Definition Note 2

The core problem is that onboarding handling of skip button interacts with completion; teams noted that activation depends on progress and firstrun, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because onboarding handling of stepper interacts with checklist; teams noted that nudge depends on confetti and quickstart, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, onboarding handling of guidance interacts with welcome; teams noted that placeholder depends on walkthrough and invite, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that onboarding handling of wizard interacts with empty state; teams noted that tutorial depends on milestone and tooltip, especially under real production load.
